resources.string: 100% on-device
Clean up your storage, safely
CleanSweep finds duplicate files, leftover installers and junk on your phone, and tells you why each one can go.
Exact copies only
Files are compared byte for byte, so a copy is never mistaken for a different file. One copy of every group always stays.
Nothing is lost by accident
What you remove goes to Safe Trash first, where you can restore it for 30 days.
You stay in control
CleanSweep never deletes anything on its own. Every removal asks for your confirmation first.
Storage access is needed
CleanSweep reads the names, sizes and contents of files on the storage of your phone and on SD cards.
This is how it finds copies of one file wherever they are, and tells which files are junk.
Files that belong to other apps are never read.
I understand, continue
Your files stay on this device
CleanSweep has no Internet access. Nothing about your files ever leaves your phone.
Android will now ask you to let CleanSweep access all files. The app uses that access only as described above.
You can allow access later from the Home screen.
Access is still off
Without access to storage, CleanSweep cannot look for anything.
Android will not ask again. You can allow storage access in the app settings.
This device has no page for it. Look for storage access in the app settings.
Access granted
